name: smwmusic-super-mario
title: Super Mario 64 - Cave Dungeon
description:
Also known as Hazy Maze Cave.
Pitch bends are based on the OST version, there's a little comment on line 55 that tells you how to change them to the N64 version instead.
Comes with two sound effects containing ASM to fade channels #0 (slap bass) and #4 (choir boys) in and out dynamically like in the original game. Instructions in the readme file.
